specification.objective: Correct the #123 canonical visual golden mismatch using only reviewed outputs from the exact Ubuntu 24.04 x64 / Flutter 3.47.2 runtime, while ensuring every desktop and mobile theme case executes and reports independently.

requirements.statement: The canonical golden test registers desktop-light, desktop-dark, mobile-light, and mobile-dark as independent test cases tagged canonical-golden, preserving each existing fixture, viewport, theme, and visual state.

The four golden cases execute on the Ubuntu 24.04 x64 runner with Flutter 3.47.2 and report each case's outcome independently; a failure in one case does not prevent remaining cases from producing their result and review artifacts.

Only a snapshot whose expected/master, actual, and diff images are produced by a canonical run tied to the candidate commit and visually reviewed may be updated; every updated PNG records its source run and SHA-256 in the validation README.
Snapshots without reviewed canonical output remain byte-identical; no production layout, behavior, matcher tolerance, CI failure semantics, or non-golden functional coverage changes.
The complete canonical-golden suite passes on the candidate after any approved snapshot updates, and all non-golden frontend functional tests pass.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The test file contains four separately registered canonical-golden cases with the existing dimensions and fixture/theme state, and a failure in one case does not skip any other case.
A canonical Ubuntu 24.04 x64 / Flutter 3.47.2 run for the exact candidate commit reports all four case results and provides actual/expected/diff artifacts for every mismatch.

Each changed PNG is byte-identical to its reviewed actual output from the candidate's canonical run; the README records the run ID, candidate SHA, Flutter version, and PNG SHA-256. Unchanged snapshots retain their baseline SHA-256.
The focused non-golden workspace shell tests and the full non-golden Flutter test suite pass; the full canonical-golden suite passes on the resulting candidate runtime.
All effective command gates in the committed Project Policy pass, and contracts and historical proof artifacts v1-v4 remain byte-identical.

invariants.statement: Preserve all v1-v4 contract and proof bytes and preserve every snapshot that lacks an individually reviewed canonical actual.
The canonical visual oracle remains Ubuntu 24.04 x64 with Flutter 3.47.2; local macOS/arm64 or Linux/arm64 renders are not snapshot sources.
Do not change production UI/layout, golden matcher tolerance, or functional test behavior to make a raster comparison pass.
Keep the golden comparison blocking and retain all non-golden functional tests.

forbidden_states.statement: A canonical snapshot is updated from an artifact not tied to the exact source commit or without review of its actual and diff.
Any snapshot without canonical evidence is changed, or historical v1-v4 contract/proof bytes are rewritten.
A local macOS/arm64 or Linux/arm64 screenshot is treated as canonical.
The golden test is skipped, made non-blocking, or the matcher is weakened.
A test failure in one viewport/theme prevents the other canonical cases from executing.

inputs.statement: Clean baseline c00ae1efb173c67081c2165db29405b1d07d509f, .polis/policy.json, contracts v1-v4, and the four issue-119 PNG snapshots.
Canonical Ubuntu 24.04 x64 / Flutter 3.47.2 run 40430110600 and its desktop-light expected/actual/diff artifact, tied to baseline c00ae1efb173c67081c2165db29405b1d07d509f.

outputs.statement: Independent canonical-golden case reporting, only individually justified snapshot updates, and corresponding source-run/hash provenance.

failure_semantics.statement: Any unreviewed snapshot, missing canonical case result, failed canonical comparison, non-golden test failure, changed historical artifact, or failed effective policy command gate blocks completion.
